description: This file contains unit tests for the DateTimeHelperService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing date formatting, comparison, range calculations, timezone handling, and week boundary calculations.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the DateTimeHelperService, verifying various date and time utility functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DateTimeHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Tests formatting of DateTime objects to ISO date string.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Tests formatting of DateTime objects to time strings.

methods.name: testIsDatesEqual
methods.description: Tests comparison of DateTime objects for date equality, including timezone differences.

methods.name: testDateDiffInHours
methods.description: Tests calculation of difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: testDateRange
methods.description: Tests generation of date ranges with specified start/end dates and interval.

methods.name: assertDateArray
methods.description: Helper method to assert that an array of DateTime objects matches expected date strings.

methods.name: testGetNow
methods.description: Verifies that the getNow method returns current date/time with matching timezone and offset.

methods.name: testGetTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Tests creation of DateTimeZone objects based on timezone offset values.

methods.name: testGetWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Tests calculation of start and end dates of the week for a given date, based on different week start day indices.
